name: Hydrocortisone 0.1g/100g Topical Cream 30g 1 Piece
description: Hydrocortisone 0.1% cream is a topical corticosteroid used to treat various skin conditions, relieving inflammation, redness, and itching. The “0.1g/100g” format means that each 100 grams of cream contains 0.1 grams of the active ingredient, or a concentration of 0.1%. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
